subject: Acme procurement readiness / PO vs card / marketplace interest
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jesse Carter <jesse@acme.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acme.com>
Date: 2026-02-03T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Quick follow-up + procurement path (PO vs card)

Hi Jesse / Tara —

Thanks again for the call earlier — great discussion about the integration patterns and expected qps. To keep things moving on our side, a couple quick items / asks:  

- Procurement path: can you confirm if Acme will pay via corporate card for initial pilot or you need a PO/contract first?  
- Marketplace: you mentioned exploring AWS Marketplace. Is that a priority or secondary to direct contract?  
- Compliance: attached a short SOC2 excerpt and our standard SOW (Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf). Let me know if you need a full report.  

Next steps I propose: I can loop in our Contracts lead (David Kim) if you need legal/PO coordination, and our AM (Laura) for onboarding milestones. If you can share the procurement contact or vendor form, I'll start pre-populating items.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, SOC2_report_excerpt.pdf

From: Jesse Carter <jesse@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-02-04T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + procurement path (PO vs card)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — clear and helpful. Short answers:  

- For pilot: we prefer to use a PO. Finance requires vendor onboarding before card payments.  
- Marketplace: we'd like to keep the option open for Marketplace, but our finance team prefers direct contracts for the first year.
- Procurement contact: looping in procurement@acme.com (they've been CC'd). They'll send the vendor packet / vendor form.

Please loop in your Contracts lead. Also, we'll need the full SOC2 report and a point of contact for invoicing.

Jesse
Jesse Carter
Director, Product Integrations | Acme Corp

Thanks for reaching out. Please complete the attached vendor form and upload the W9. Also share a standard invoice email and remittance address. Once vendor onboarding is complete we can issue a PO (typical lead time ~ 7-10 business days).

We will also need: full SOC2 report, DPA (if not included in SOW), and any export compliance statements.

Procurement Team

Hi Jesse / procurement team —

Quick weekly check-in on the PO path. Wanted to surface a couple common blockers and offer help:  

- Vendor packet completeness: we uploaded the items you requested on 2/9. Any missing fields we should fill?  
- DPA redlines: David can do a 20–30 minute call with legal to speed alignment if helpful.  
- Marketplace: if your team prefers Marketplace invoicing long-term we can provide marketplace pricing and timeline in parallel.

If you can share the expected PO issuance date or the next blocker, I’ll coordinate internal resources to keep things moving. Appreciate any update — short replies are totally fine.

Thanks!
